labeling_policy: Q&A answer text alone is not used to promote answerability.
Questions whose conclusion depends on remuneration/add-on/reduction rules remain REVIEW_REQUIRED while the corresponding human review ledgers are not complete.
A question may contain a separately verified staffing fact, but the requested remuneration conclusion is not decomposed into ANSWER unless the remuneration condition itself is reviewed.
No case was removed or relabeled to improve class balance.
